name: Forestry mulching
summary: Land clearing priced per acre from machine hours and machine running cost, plus a mobilization trip.

items.label: Mulch medium brush, 6 ft head
items.source: acresPerHourFrom: 6 ft head x 42 ft/min x 85% terrain x 60 x 80% cutting / 43,560 / 1 pass = 0.2360 ac/h (DENSITY_CLASSES medium-brush; index.html); machine cost beyond the operator $78.70/h = fuel 5 gal x $3.90 + teeth $1,800/250 h + maintenance $12 + ($2,400 + $4,800/12)/70 h (machineCostPerHour; index.html); 3 acres default

items.label: Mobilization trip (float machine in and out)
items.source: 2.5 operator hours per trip; 70 mi x $1.35/mi truck and trailer; 1 trip (index.html mobilizationHoursEach, mobilizationMilesEach, truckCostPerMile, mobilizationTrips)

specialistModels: Production rate from head width, advance speed, passes, cutting share and terrain, a machine-hour cost build (fuel, teeth, reserve, payment over billable hours), and a density-class comparison.
